items.heading: Plov Uzbek
details: Key ingredients: rice, lamb, carrot, chickpeas, cumin
Brown lamb with onion in a wide pot until golden.
Add julienned carrot and cook until softened.
Layer rice and soaked chickpeas over the meat.
Add water and simmer covered until the rice is tender and fragrant.

items.heading: Samsa
details: Key ingredients: flaky dough, ground lamb, onion, cumin
Mix ground lamb with chopped onion and cumin.
Wrap the filling in triangles or squares of flaky dough.
Brush with egg wash and place in a hot oven or tandoor.
Bake until the pastry is deeply golden and crisp.

items.heading: Plov
details: Ingredients: rice, oil/ghee, onion, whole spices, ginger-garlic, vegetables or meat, salt and stock/water.
Rinse and partly cook the rice.
Brown onion and spices, cook the vegetables/meat with seasoning, layer with rice and steam covered on low heat until tender.

details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.

Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
